structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), 5139282. The page marks it "הזול" and it ends highest at 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, with a 0.02% fund fee and 1,057 ₪ in account fees.

stuck.why: They're set to 10,000 today and 500 a month, not my 30,000, so I don't know if the winner stays the same for my amount
The numbers sit in coloured pieces and the legend is a line further down, so I had to match colours back and forth and guessed pink = tax, yellow = custody fee
Every fund repeats the same chips (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, קרן סל, מס גם על שינוי המטבע), so I kept rereading them to find what's different
I didn't understand what hedging is or why it matters; I'd have closed the page here
It starts from MTF / ירושלים, which I never picked, and that confused me
